# Copilot Prompting and Checks

Use when creating prompt demonstrations, practice challenges, quizzes, or knowledge checks for Microsoft 365 Copilot.

Start with a realistic task and a weak prompt. Have learners diagnose missing context, goal, source, or expectations, then improve it. Show that prompt quality is not a guarantee of truth and require output review. Vary prompts by app, audience, source, format, constraints, and success criteria. Write checks that test choice of starting surface, grounding, permissions, verification, and responsible use—not memorization of a transient UI label. Include the correct answer, rationale, why alternatives fail, and a remediation prompt.
